== Trivia ==
* During the beta of Prophecies, this skill was not elite. See the [http://web.archive.org/web/20090406144129/http://www.gamespot.com/pc/rpg/guildwars/preview_6111324.html GameSpot Preview of the Ranger].
* [[Poison Arrow]] and Quick Shot are tied for the lowest recharge of bow attack skills that don't remove a preparation, making them potentially effective to trigger the effects of [[anthem]]s, [[song]]s and damage from [[Expert Focus]].
